cohort: 80 pregnant women aged ≥ 35 years at the second trimester of pregnancy, 80 gestational week-matched pregnant women aged < 35 years, and 80 non-pregnant women aged ≥ 35 years without any comorbidity
finding: A LV-GLS less negative than - 18% allows to identify, among older pregnant women, those with an increased risk of AMO.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section (ECS) was detected in 8.7% of women.
